from rdflib import Graph
from rdflib import Namespace

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")
uni = Namespace("http://university.org/ontology/")

# Check all professors and their roles
print("=== ALL PERSONS WITH 'Professor' IN ROLE ===")
for s, p, o in g.triples((None, uni.role, None)):
    if "Professor" in str(o):
        name = g.value(s, uni.hasName)
        works_in = list(g.objects(s, uni.worksIn))
        print(f"  {name} ({o}) -> works in: {[str(w) for w in works_in]}")

print("\n=== STUDENT ENROLLMENTS ===")
for s, p, o in g.triples((None, uni.isEnrolledIn, None)):
    name = g.value(s, uni.hasName)
    course = g.value(s, uni.isEnrolledIn)
    enroll_date = g.value(s, uni.hasEnrollmentDate)
    grad_date = g.value(s, uni.hasGraduationDate)
    print(f"  {name} -> {course} (enrolled: {enroll_date}, graduated: {grad_date})")

print("\n=== COURSES AND DEPARTMENTS ===")
for c in g.objects(None, uni.isTaughtIn):
    print(f"  Course: {c} -> taught in: {c}")

# Let me check which courses are taught in which departments
print("\n=== COURSE -> DEPARTMENT ===")
for course in g.subjects(None, uni.isTaughtIn):
    dept = g.value(course, uni.isTaughtIn)
    print(f"  {course} -> {dept}")

# Check departments -> universities
print("\n=== DEPARTMENT -> UNIVERSITY -> COUNTRY ===")
for dept in g.subjects(None, uni.belongsTo):
    uni_obj = g.value(dept, uni.belongsTo)
    country = g.value(uni_obj, uni.locatedInCountry)
    print(f"  {dept} -> {uni_obj} -> {country}")

from rdflib import Graph
from rdflib import Namespace

g = Graph()
g.parse("/app/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")
uni = Namespace("http://university.org/ontology/")

# Check isTaughtIn triples
print("=== isTaughtIn triples ===")
for s, p, o in g.triples((None, uni.isTaughtIn, None)):
    print(f"  {s} -> isTaughtIn -> {o}")

# Check what the course objects are
print("\n=== Course objects ===")
for s in g.subjects(uni.a, uni.Course):
    name = g.value(s, uni.hasName) if g.value(s, uni.hasName) else str(s)
    taught_in = list(g.objects(s, uni.isTaughtIn))
    print(f"  {s} (name={name}) -> taught in: {taught_in}")

# Check departments
print("\n=== Department objects ===")
for s in g.subjects(uni.a, uni.Department):
    belongs = list(g.objects(s, uni.belongsTo))
    print(f"  {s} -> belongs to: {belongs}")

# Check universities
print("\n=== University objects ===")
for s in g.subjects(uni.a, uni.University):
    country = g.value(s, uni.locatedInCountry)
    name = g.value(s, uni.hasName)
    print(f"  {s} (name={name}) -> country: {country}")
